newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average down more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average down more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 100 points on Friday after stronger-than-expected housing starts in April revived concern that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates to slow the economy's growth.
At 2:32 p.m. EDT 1832 GMT, the Dow was off 100.97 points at 7,232.58, and the Nasdaq index was off 12.04 points at 1,341.54. The New York Stock Exchange reactivated its curbs on program trading.
